label: O(n*m)
reason: PROVED 2026-09-17. Bound 4050*(if n>0 then n else 0)+5. m is the LITERAL 2009 in the source, not an input, so it cannot scale and folds into the constant. The row is O(n) and the O(n*m) label overstates it. This is a strictly tighter bound than the label, which is the one way an upper bound can refute one. A literal is not the value-versus-size case: that convention governs quantities that vary with input.
